location_note: Dar el-Consul compound, 13 'Aqabat el-Takiyya St., Old City of Jerusalem; no map reference. Placed by name (Jerusalem, Z4).
notes: Inscribed Jerash-type lamp found at the bottom of a rock-hewn drainage channel in Room 105 of a row of shops by the Western Cardo. The channel's date is not stated (rooms earlier than or contemporary with it; lamp arrived after disuse). The Cardo's central drain is cited from Johns 1948; not coded.

features.subtype: rock-hewn, slab-covered drainage channel (L104, L112; 0.25 m wide, 6 m long) in the floor of Room 105
features.period: not stated; out of use before the Early Islamic lamp reached it
features.quote: A narrow, shallow westward sloping drainage channel
